title: Margaret Hamilton has died
summary: MIT News reports on the passing of Margaret Hamilton, the pioneering computer scientist who led the software development team for NASA's Apollo program and coined the term 'software engineering'.
problem_solved: This is a news obituary marking the death of a computing legend who pioneered software engineering practices and developed flight software for the Apollo missions.
why_valuable: Margaret Hamilton's work established software engineering as a discipline and her contributions were critical to the success of the Apollo moon landings, influencing all software development practices that followed.
